name: Wenzhou-Kean University
summary: China-US university in Wenzhou, Zhejiang, conferring bachelor degrees from Wenzhou-Kean University and Kean University.

ib.text: 2027 applicants submit school records and graduation evidence; IB scores are optional supporting material. No IB admission minimum is published. English evidence and sometimes credential evaluation are needed.

programmes.name: Global Business (B.S.)
programmes.about: A Bachelor of Science covering international markets, cross-cultural management and global business strategy, with a practical client-facing project.
programmes.overview: Students investigate foreign-exchange management, international capital markets, treasury operations and emerging markets. The course also examines how culture, management values and international relationships shape business strategy. A Global Business Practicum brings these themes together in team-based work on a client problem; the university describes collaboration across cultures and the possibility of work with an overseas host. The programme provides preparation for roles in internationally active businesses and entrepreneurial organisations.

flagshipSource.title: Global Business: Zhejiang provincial first-class undergraduate programme

programmes.selectionNote: Review of academic records and personal statement; optional exam scores can support the application. No universal IB admission score is published.

programmes.name: Architectural Studies
programmes.about: A studio-based Bachelor of Arts exploring architectural design, history, building systems and the social and environmental dimensions of the built environment.
programmes.overview: Students combine architectural history and theory with structural systems, urban and landscape planning, ecology and building regulations. Design studios run each semester, using drawing, digital representation, physical model-making and faculty-guided projects. The school stresses architecture as a public and ecological practice, with collaboration and presentation integral to studio learning. Graduates may pursue architecture-related design work or further professional study; the separate Master of Architecture, not this B.A., is identified as NAAB-accredited.

flagshipSource.title: Architectural Studies: provincial first-class programme and studio-based curriculum

programmes.selectionNote: Academic and personal-statement review plus programme-specific creative materials; confirm the current architecture portfolio brief and submission channel.
programmes.ib: Confirm architecture portfolio requirements: older official checklists disagree on the submission channel. The BA is distinct from a later professional architecture degree.

notes: The international route requires foreign nationality, with additional residence rules for some applicants of Chinese heritage; under-18 applicants need a guardian in China.
2027 tuition is CNY 88,000 a year, subject to approval; housing, insurance, the CNY 400 application charge and a tuition-credit deposit are separate.
Freshman scholarship applications close 15 June 2027. IB 30/32 are scholarship consideration criteria, not admission minima or guaranteed awards.
